title: Outdoor Grilled Australian Chicken Sandwich
description: A cultured and juicy post-workout Australian dish featuring almond essence, served on double-rise-bread, friendly to all including those who follow Buddhist temple dietary guidelines.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix almond essence, olive oil, salt, and pepper to create a marinade.
Place the chicken breast in the marinade and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Grill the chicken for 20 minutes or until it reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit internally.
Toast the double-rise-bread on the grill for 2 minutes.
Assemble the sandwich with grilled chicken, lettuce, and tomato on toasted double-rise-bread.
Let the sandwich cool for a few minutes before serving.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
